description: Short verbatim quotes from the full texts of Chen et al. 2026 (RESS 267:111894, doi:10.1016/j.ress.2025.111894) and Asaadi et al. 2025 (J. Process Control 155:103536, doi:10.1016/j.jprocont.2025.103536), machine-checked against pdftotext output of the publisher PDFs supplied by the author (SHA-256 listed). The PDFs are not redistributed.
normalization: NFKC; soft hyphens and line-break hyphenation removed; whitespace collapsed

CH1_multiple_pattern_normality.quote: The variation of OCs in normal operating states (OSs) can cause the multiple pattern normality to emerge in the monitoring data.

CH2_no_universal_threshold.quote: Training AD models using data samples from different OCs cannot provide a universal HI threshold applicable to all conditions, and the missed alarm or false alarm rate rises.

CH3_oc_conditional_inputs.quote: by incorporating OC variables as conditional inputs in the variational autoencoder (VAE) model, and decoupled modeling of equipment states and external OCs is achieved.

CH4_contribution.quote: was proposed based on conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) optimized with self-attention (SA) in this paper.

CH5_ds02_units.quote: Our work focuses on DS02, from which six long-range flight engine units (U2, U5, U10, U16, U18, U20) are selected as the research subjects.

CH6_split.quote: In dataset B, the first 10 flight cycles of each engine are considered healthy samples and used for training, while subsequent flight cycles of U5 and U16 are reserved for testing.

CH7_dataset_b_task.quote: mainly used to evaluate the correlation between the constructed HI and the engine's actual health status.

CH8_kde_threshold.quote: When confidence level is set at 95 %, the corresponding lower bound is utilized as the LRP threshold for AD

CH9_inputs.quote: only 4 scenario descriptors and 14 sensor measurements are employed as model inputs.

AS1_stationary_assumption.quote: Traditional alarm design methods often assume stationary, which limits their ability to reflect the evolving nature of incipient faults.

AS2_time_variant_indices.quote: a non-stationary model should provide time-variant FAR and MAR, and the alarm system should be designed based on these time-variant indices, rather than relying on constant mean values.

AS3_aad_misleading.quote: In particular, the AAD metric reflects realistic delay patterns and avoids the misleading interpretations often associated with stationary models.

AS4_policies_change_indices.quote: However, when techniques such as Deadband, Filtering, and Delay Timers are introduced, we must recalculate the FAR, MAR, and AAD accordingly.

AS5_zones_fault_progression.quote: When a process variable is affected by an incipient fault, its behavior can be divided into distinct operational zones that capture the progression of the fault and the system's response.

AS6_univariate_tep.quote: The proposed method is validated through Monte Carlo simulations and demonstrated using the Tennessee Eastman Process benchmark.

AS7_design_levers.quote: including adjustments in trip points, implementation of deadband mechanisms, utilization of delay timers, and application of signal filtering.
